segments.he: אין כו' ואם כו'. כלוי דרבא בע"ז ס"ו ב' כוותיה ועוד דברייתא אין צולין כו' כוותיה דייקא דלרב צריך לחסורי דלא כגאונים ור"ת שפסקו כרב משום דתני רב כהנא כוותיה ורבא מפרזקיא עבד עובדא וכן מר בר ר"א מדקאמר אפילו במילחא משמע דמודה לקמייתא וכתב רי"ף דכולהו אתיין אף כלוי דכל הני לכתחלה ולוי לא שרי אלא בדיעבד דהא שצלאו קאמר ול"ק צולין [ואדרבה מדבריהם משמע דס"ל כלוי דלרב אף במילחא יש לאסור כמ"ש בפ"ב (ל' ועתוס' שם א' ד"ה ואפי') שם אין טשין כו' ואם כו'] ואף שהר"ן הקשה ע"ז דא"כ מאי פריך מיתיבי אין צולין כו' וכן הקשו התוס' שם ד"ה מאי כו' ועוד דרבא דאזיל בשיטתיה מתיר בבת תיהא לכתחלה ועוד דבירושלמי פ"י דתרומות הלכה ב' מהו לצלות שני שפודין אחד של בשר שחוטה ואחד של בשר נבילה בתנור אחד רב ירמיה בשם רב אסור ושמואל בשם לוי מותר פליגא מתני' על רב אין צולין שני פסחים בתנור אחד מפני התערובת לא אמרו אלא מפני דתערובת הא שלא מפני התערובת לא וכן הקשה הרשב"א מ"מ כתב הרשב"א שיש לחוש לסברת הראשונים לאסור לכתחלה [ותירץ בש"ד סי' ל"ה דהא דרבא דמתיר לכתחלה בת תיהא שאני דלא מפטמא ולא עביד לריחא ועתוס' בע"ז שם והא דפריך מיתיבי כו' כתב הרשב"א כיון דתרווייהו התירא הוא יש להתיר אף לכתחלה וההיא דירושלמי קשיא מ"מ כיון דבגמ' דידן משמע דיעבד דוקא] וער"ן שיישב ודחה ראיית ר"ת בענין אחר וכתב הרי"ף עוד ואע"ג דר"ל דאמר בפת חמה כו' כלוי הוא כמ"ש והאי נמי כו' לית הלכתא כר"ל נגד לוי ורבא וליתא להא דר"ל כלל ובכולהו פליגי והלכה כרבי יהודה לגבי ר"מ כמ"ש בפ"ד דעירובין (מ"ו ב' נ"ב א') וגם ר' יוסי ס"ל דל"פ על ר"י אלא מפני שהשעורים שואבות עצמו של יין ולאו ריחא הוא וראיה דר"מ אסר ולא מפרש טעמיה ור' יוסי הוצרך לפרש וכ"פ הרמב"ם וכר' יוסי ועס"ד וכזה י"ל גם אהא דרב כהנא ורבא מפרזקיא דאדחו מקמא רבא דבתרא הוא ומר בר ר"א לא מודה להו וכ"כ הר"ן:
segments.en: One may not, etc. And if, etc. Nullified of Rava in Avodah Zarah 66b is like him; and the baraita one may not roast, etc., is like him — precisely according to Rav one must subtract not like Geonim and Rabeinu Tam who ruled like Rav because Rav Kahana taught like him and Rava of Parzika acted, and so Mar bar Rav Ashi — from that he said even in salt it implies he agrees to the first view; and Rif wrote that all these come even nullified of all these l'chatchila and Levi permits only b'dieved for he said they roasted; and there is no contradiction roasting [rather from their words it implies they hold nullified of Rav even in salt one should forbid as written in chapter 2 that one may not cover, etc., and if, etc.] — and even though Ran challenged on this that if so what does it challenge from the baraita one may not roast, etc., and Tosafot challenged there — and Rava who follows his approach permits his daughter l'chatchila; and in Yerushalmi Terumot chapter 10 halachah 2: how to roast two spits one of shechted meat and one of nevelah in one oven — Rav Yirmiyah in name of Rav forbids and Shmuel in name of Levi permits — contradicts the mishnah on Rav one may not roast two Pesachim in one oven on account of mixture — they said only on account of mixture of bodies, not on account of mixture otherwise not — and Rashba challenged; nevertheless Rashba wrote one should be concerned for the early ones to forbid l'chatchila [and resolved in ShaDa siman 35 that Rava who permits his daughter l'chatchila is different for it does not season and does not make smell; and Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there and the baraita challenged wrote Rashba since both are heter one may permit even l'chatchila — and the Yerushalmi is difficult; nevertheless since in our Gemara it implies b'dieved specifically]; and Or Zarua resolved and rejected Rabeinu Tam's proof on another matter; and Rif wrote further even though R' Levi said hot bread, etc., nullified as written — and this too, etc., the halachah is not like R' Levi against Levi and Rava and R' Levi does not exist at all and in all of them they disagree; and the halachah is like R' Yehudah against R' Meir as written in Eruvin chapter 4; and R' Yossi holds not to disagree on R' Yehudah except because barley draws the wine itself and it is not reicha; and proof R' Meir forbade and did not explain his reason and R' Yossi needed to explain — and so Rambam and like R' Yossi and investigate; and likewise one may say on Rav Kahana and Rava of Parzika who rejected the first Rava — the latter is he and Mar bar Rav Ashi did not agree with them — and so Ran:

segments.he: ואם התנור כו' ופיו כו'. תוספות בע"ז שם ד"ה רבא אף לרב:
segments.en: And if the oven, etc., and its mouth, etc. Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there s.v. Rava even according to Rav:

segments.he: ובלבד כו'. דאפי' בצונן אמרו בר"פ כ"ה ק"ז כ' ובלבד כו':
segments.en: Provided, etc. For even cold they said in beginning of chapter 25 siman 107 wrote provided, etc.:

segments.he: ואם א' כו' דהוי כעין שתי קדירות דשרי אפילו לרב תוספות פסחים ד"ה אסרה כו':
segments.en: And if one, etc., for it is like two pots which is permitted even according to Rav — Tosafot Pesachim s.v. it forbade, etc.:

segments.he: וה"ה כו'. כמ"ש שם תני רב כהנא כו':
segments.en: And the same applies, etc. As written there Rav Kahana taught, etc.:

segments.he: ונוהגין כו'. כ"פ או"ה וס"ל דמ"ש תוספות לחלק בין תנור גדול לקטן היינו בדיעבד לרב אבל לדידן דקי"ל כלוי אין נ"מ בזה אבל כל הפוסקים כתבו כמ"ש בש"ע ועב"י סי' צ"ז:
segments.en: And we practice, etc. So too Issur VeHeter and he holds that what Tosafot wrote to distinguish between large and small oven is b'dieved for Rav — but for us who establish nullified there is no difference; but all poskim wrote as in Shulchan Aruch and ben yomo siman 97:

segments.he: ואם אפה כו'. כנ"ל מהא דתני רב כהנא ועבד רבא כו':
segments.en: And if he baked, etc. As above from Rav Kahana taught and Rava acted, etc.:

segments.he: וכן אם כו'. דמה שהתיר לוי בשל ישראל דהוי דיעבד:
segments.en: And likewise if, etc. For what Levi permitted of an Israelite is b'dieved:

segments.he: מותר בשניהם. ר"ל אפילו בבב"ח שלא כדעת הרי"ף שכתב עוד טעם אחר על הא דרב כהנא משום דכיון דאפשר לאכלו בלא כותח הוי דשיל"מ ואפילו באלף לא בטיל ובכה"ג מודה לוי וכשיטתו שכתב דרב דאוסר אזיל לטעמיה דס"ל מין במינו במשהו ולהכי לא קי"ל כרב דקי"ל בששים אבל בכה"ג מודה לרב. אבל הקשו עליו דכה"ג לא מקרי דשיל"מ כמ"ש ביבמות פ"ב א' ועוד דדשיל"מ בשא"מ בטיל ועוד דא"כ דגים שעלו בקערה למה מותר ועוד דהא אף בפ"ע מתיר דבא בבת תיהא ואף שי"ל כל הקושיות ב' קושיות הראשונות עבר"ן פ"ו דנררים (נ"ב א') ומדגים אין קושיא דשם אף משהו ליכא ומבת תיהא לא קשיא כמ"ש בש"ד כנ"ל מ"מ העיקר כתירוץ הראשון של הרי"ף כנ"ל אבל בעיקר דינא השיג בד"מ ובת"ח דהא שמן ודבש של עובדי כוכבים מותר לכתחלה לקנותם משום נטל"פ כמ"ש בפ"ב דע"ז ולא אמרינן שהוא לכתחלה וגם מה שהתיר הרב גם בבב"ח צ"ע כיון דאפשר לאכלו בלא חלב הוי לכתחלה כמ"ש הרי"ף וכ"פ הרמב"ם בפ"מ דאסור ולא חילק אף שפסק כלוי בפט"ו וכן בגמ' סתמו אסור לאכלו בכותח:
segments.en: Permitted in both. Meaning even in gentile cooking unlike Rif who wrote another reason on Rav Kahana because since it is possible to eat without kutach it is something that has a permitted aspect and even in a thousand it is not nullified — in such a case Levi agrees and according to his approach that Rav who forbids goes according to his taste because he holds min b'mino in any amount — therefore we do not establish like Rav because we establish in sixty — but in such a case he agrees to Rav. But they challenged him that such a case is not called something that has a permitted aspect as in Yevamot chapter 2; and something that has a permitted aspect in min she'eino mino is nullified; and if so fish that came up to the bowl why permitted; and behold even by itself he permits in his daughter; and even if the first two questions were answered in chapter 6 of Nedarim and regarding fish there is no question for there is not even any amount and from his daughter there is no question as in ShaDa as above — nevertheless the main point is Rif's first answer as above; but in the main law Darkei Moshe and Turei Chayim challenged — behold oil and honey of gentiles permitted l'chatchila to buy on account of nat bar lichtamei as in chapter 2 of Avodah Zarah and we do not say it is l'chatchila; and also what the Rav permitted even in gentile cooking requires study since it is possible to eat without milk it is l'chatchila as Rif wrote and so Rambam in chapter 8 of forbidden and did not distinguish even though he ruled nullified in forbidden foods — and so in the Gemara they concluded forbidden to eat in kutach:

segments.he: י"א דאין כו'. דדמי לפת חמה וחבית פתוחה דאסור כמ"ש בס"ד דאף לוי מודה (וע"ל ס"ק ל'):
segments.en: Some say there is no, etc. For it is similar to hot bread and open barrel which is forbidden as written in seif 4 that even Levi agrees (and see s.k. 30):

segments.he: ובמקום כו'. כסברת כל הפוסקים שחולקים עליו:
segments.en: And in a place, etc. According to the view of all poskim who disagree with him:

segments.he: ואם האיסור כו'. בזה מתורץ דר"ל ל"פ אלוי ורבא דלא כרי"ף ורמב"ם וכמ"ש תוס' בע"ז שם דבפת חמה וחבית פתוחה אף רבא מודה וכמ"ש הטוש"ע בס"ד:
segments.en: And if the issur, etc. With this is resolved that R' Levi does not disagree with Levi and Rava unlike Rif and Rambam and as Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there in hot bread and open barrel even Rava agrees and as Shulchan Aruch wrote in seif 4:

segments.he: וכ"ש אם כו'. עסי' קכ"ב ס"ג בהג"ה י"א דבדברים כו' אבל כו':
segments.en: And all the more if, etc. See siman 122 seif 3 in hagahah some say in things, etc., but, etc.

segments.he: (ליקוט) וכ"ש אם כו'. כן למד מדברי או"ה כמ"ש בסי' קכ"ב ס"ג בהג"ה אבל אם כו' ודבריו תמוהין מהא דפ"י דתרומות חסית כו' וע"כ צריך לחלק בין בעין ובין איסור הבלוע ועמ"ש שם (ע"כ):
segments.en: (Likut) And all the more if, etc. So he learned from Issur VeHeter as in siman 122 seif 3 in hagahah but if, etc., and his words are astonishing from Terumot chapter 10 chasis, etc., and one must distinguish between in the substance and absorbed issur — see there (end):

segments.he: אבל אם א' כו'. כנ"ל בש"ע וכמו פת חמה וחבית מכוסה:
segments.en: But if one, etc. As above in Shulchan Aruch and like hot bread and covered barrel.

segments.he: (ליקוט) אבל אם א' מהם כו'. מהבית סתומה דמותר אף בפת חמה ואף לר' יוסי אין אסור אלא בשעורים שהם שואבות אבל בלא"ה כמו בחטים מותר וכן קי"ל בס"ד (ע"כ):
segments.en: (Likut) But if one of them, etc. From covered house which is permitted even in hot bread and even according to R' Yossi it is forbidden only in barley which draws — but otherwise like wheat permitted and so we establish in seif 4 (end):

segments.he: אם אפו או כו'. כ"כ באו"ה והוא אזיל לשיטתו דאפילו בתנור סתום אוסר בדיעבד משום דהוי כי הבית פתוחה ופת חמה וכ"כ ש"ד בשם ראב"ן וז"ש מגולין כנ"ל אבל מדברי תוס' בע"ז שם משמע דדוקא לרב שכתבו ולענין ריחא דהתם כו' ה"מ כו' וה"ה כו' וז"ש לעיל ובמקום הפסד כו' ואעפ"כ לא רצה להקל כאן:
segments.en: If they baked or, etc. So Issur VeHeter wrote and he follows his approach that even in closed oven he forbids b'dieved because it is like the house open and hot bread — and so ShaDa in name of Raavan and what he wrote uncovered as above; but from Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there it implies specifically according to Rav as they wrote and regarding reicha there, etc., this applies, etc., and the same, etc., and what he wrote above and in place of loss, etc., and nevertheless he did not want to be lenient here:

segments.he: וה"ה אם כו'. שדין א' להם כנ"ל:
segments.en: And the same if, etc. For they have one law as above:

segments.he: אבל בזא"ז כו'. כמ"ש בע"ז שם שאני התם דמקליא כו' ואע"ג שנשאר הריח בתנור ואף אביי מודה:
segments.en: But one after the other, etc. As in Avodah Zarah there it is different there because it weakens, etc., and even though smell remains in the oven even Abbaye agrees:

segments.he: אא"כ כו'. כנ"ל מהא דמכשירין:
segments.en: Unless, etc. As above from we kasher:

segments.he: ולצורך הפסד כו'. אבל בלא"ה צריך בכל חתיכה ס' דלא ידעינן לאיזה צד הלך הריח אלא כיון דהכל בספק כולם מצטרפין כמ"ש בסי' קי"א ס"ז והרב הולך לשטתו שכתב שם ג"כ ולצורך הפסד ואע"ג שכ' שם ומיהו אין לאכלו כו' בריחא יש להקל כמ"ש באו"ה:
segments.en: And for need of loss, etc. But otherwise each piece needs sixty for we do not know to which side the smell went; but since all are in doubt all join as written in siman 111 seif 7; and the Rav follows his approach that he wrote there too and for need of loss; and even though he wrote there nevertheless one may not eat, etc., in reicha one may be lenient as Issur VeHeter wrote:

segments.he: י"א דאיסור כו'. כ"כ תוס' בע"ז שם וכ"ד הרי"ף שכתב דלכך לא קי"ל כרב לפי דאזיל לטעמיה כנ"ל וכן הא דאסרו למיכל בכותחא משום דהוי דשיל"מ:
segments.en: Some say issur, etc. So Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there and so Rif who wrote therefore we do not establish like Rav because he goes according to his taste as above; and the fact they forbade eating in kutach because it is something that has a permitted aspect.

segments.he: (ליקוט) י"א דאיסור האוסר כו' פלוגתא זו תליא בפלוגתא דרי"ף ותוס' דרי"ף מביא ראיה דהלכה כלוי מהא דע"ז בבת תיהא ושם איתא לאיסורא בעינא ואפ"ה מותר כ"ש בתערובת כיון דבעיניה לא אסור כלל וכמו שהקשה הר"ן על הרי"ף בפ' ג"ה על מ"ש דרב אזיל לטעמיה כו' וכן כותחא דאסור משום דדשיל"מ הוא ע"ש אבל לתוס' דס"ל דלא תליא בהא דע"ז דאף למ"ד לאו מילתא היא שם אסור דבעיניה הוא ורבא דמתיר משום דמזיק וכמ"ש תוס' שם ד"ה אביי וד"ה רבא ע"ש ולהכי אסרי תוס' בזילוף שם ולדברי רי"ף היה מותר אבל לפי' אסור משום דנהנה וכן בתערובת ובזה תליא פלוגתא אם הלכה כרב או כלוי וכן ההיא דס"ד אתיא כתוס' אבל לרי"ף ליתא דר"ל כלל ואפילו בחבית פתוחה ופת חמה מותר דלאו מילתא היא ואפילו בעיניה מותר וכמ"ש הרי"ף שם וכ"פ הרמב"ם וגם מ"ש בס"ה בהג"ה ואסור לזלוף כו' כנ"ל ומ"ש בס"ו שק כו' ועבה"ג שם ולכאורה תמוה דא"כ גם באכילה יהא מותר ועוד מה בכך שאינו מכוין פסיק רישא הוא ועתוס' בפ' כ"ש כ"ה ב' ד"ה לא אפשר כו' ומיירי כו' אלא דרשב"א אזיל לשיטתו שכתב בהא דס"ז בשמים כו' דאסור ומחלק בין וורד והדם דעיקרו לריח דאסור משא"כ ביין דאין עיקרו לריח להכי לאו מילתא וכשיטת הרי"ף דמדמי להא דפ' כ"צ דשם ג"כ הבשר עיקרו לאו לריח אבל תוס' לא ס"ל האי חילוק אלא בבת תיהא משום דמזיקו וכמ"ש תוס' שם ושם י"ב ב' ד"ה אלא כו' וכמ"ש בס"ז ולפ"ז אסור כאן (ע"כ):
segments.en: (Likut) Some say issur that forbids, etc. This dispute depends on the dispute of Rif and Tosafot — Rif brings proof halachah is nullified from Avodah Zarah in his daughter and there it is issur in substance and nevertheless permitted — all the more in mixture since in substance it is not forbidden at all; and as Ran challenged Rif in chapter Gid on what Rif wrote Rav goes according to his taste, etc.; and kutach forbidden because something that has a permitted aspect — see there; but for Tosafot who hold it does not depend on Avodah Zarah there — even for one who says it is not significant there it is forbidden in substance and Rava who permits because it harms as Tosafot there s.v. Abbaye and s.v. Rava — see there — therefore Tosafot forbid ziluf there and according to Rif it would be permitted but his explanation is forbidden because one benefits; and likewise in mixture — and on this depends whether halachah is like Rav or nullified; and the matter in seif 4 comes like Tosafot but for Rif it does not exist and R' Levi at all and even in open barrel and hot bread permitted for it is not significant and even in substance permitted as Rif wrote and so Rambam; and what is written in seif 5 in hagahah and forbidden to ziluf, etc., as above; and what is written in seif 6 sack, etc., and Be'er HaGolah there — and at first glance it is astonishing for if so also in eating it should be permitted; and furthermore what is it that he does not intend — it is pesik reisha; and Tosafot in chapter 25 daf 25 s.v. not possible, etc., deals, etc., except Rashba follows his approach that he wrote in seif 7 in spices, etc., forbidden and distinguishes between rose and blood whose essence is for smell which is forbidden unlike wine whose essence is not for smell therefore it is not significant; and according to Rif who compares to chapter 25 there too meat's essence is not for smell; but Tosafot do not hold this distinction except in his daughter because it harms as Tosafot there and there 12b s.v. except, etc., and as in seif 7 — and accordingly forbidden here (end):

segments.he: אם כו'. דלא כתוס' שם ועש"ך:
segments.en: If, etc. Not like Tosafot there and Shach:

segments.he: וי"א כו'. וראייתו מלחמי תודה שהיו כולן נאפות בתנור אחד דלא מצינו נאפות בפ"ע אלא שתי הלחם ולחם הפנים כמ"ש ברפי"א דמנחות וס"ל דאין לחלק בין תנור גדול לקמן דאל"כ הא מחזיק עשרים עשרונים היה וגם לפי מ"ש הרשב"א דפלוגתייהו דוקא בא' מהן שמן כמ"ש בגמ' וכ"כ תוס' שם ד"ה נימא אין ראיה משם. ונ"ל ראיה מדפריך שם לרב מאין צולין כו' דלמא רב לא אסר אלא מין במינו וגדי וטלה מץ בשא"מ הוא כמ"ש ב"י סי' צ"ח בשם האגור אלאע"כ דאין חילוק וז"ש שם מ"ל גדי וגדי ומ"ל כו' ודלא כרי"ף וכן דקאמר שם לרב נימא כו' הא בכה"ג אף רב מורה וכן בע"ז פריך מכמון של תרומה ומדפריך בפשיטות ש"מ דאין לחלק:
segments.en: And some say, etc. And his proof from Lechem HaPanim that all were baked in one oven — we do not find baked separately except the two loaves and Lechem HaPanim as in Rif chapter 1 of Menachot; and he holds one should not distinguish between large and small oven below — otherwise behold it holds twenty tenths; and also according to Rashba their dispute is specifically when one of them is fatty as in the Gemara and so Tosafot there s.v. let us say there is no proof from there. And it seems proof from that it challenges Rav from one may not roast, etc. — perhaps Rav forbade only min b'mino and kid and lamb is min she'eino mino as Beit Yosef siman 98 in name of Agur — if so there is no distinction and what is written there let us say kid and kid and let us say, etc., unlike Rif; and that it says there for Rav let us say, etc., even in such a case Rav instructs; and likewise in Avodah Zarah it challenges from terumah cumin and from the simple challenge it implies there is no distinction:

en_segments: One may not, etc. And if, etc. Nullified of Rava in Avodah Zarah 66b is like him; and the baraita one may not roast, etc., is like him — precisely according to Rav one must subtract not like Geonim and Rabeinu Tam who ruled like Rav because Rav Kahana taught like him and Rava of Parzika acted, and so Mar bar Rav Ashi — from that he said even in salt it implies he agrees to the first view; and Rif wrote that all these come even nullified of all these l'chatchila and Levi permits only b'dieved for he said they roasted; and there is no contradiction roasting [rather from their words it implies they hold nullified of Rav even in salt one should forbid as written in chapter 2 that one may not cover, etc., and if, etc.] — and even though Ran challenged on this that if so what does it challenge from the baraita one may not roast, etc., and Tosafot challenged there — and Rava who follows his approach permits his daughter l'chatchila; and in Yerushalmi Terumot chapter 10 halachah 2: how to roast two spits one of shechted meat and one of nevelah in one oven — Rav Yirmiyah in name of Rav forbids and Shmuel in name of Levi permits — contradicts the mishnah on Rav one may not roast two Pesachim in one oven on account of mixture — they said only on account of mixture of bodies, not on account of mixture otherwise not — and Rashba challenged; nevertheless Rashba wrote one should be concerned for the early ones to forbid l'chatchila [and resolved in ShaDa siman 35 that Rava who permits his daughter l'chatchila is different for it does not season and does not make smell; and Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there and the baraita challenged wrote Rashba since both are heter one may permit even l'chatchila — and the Yerushalmi is difficult; nevertheless since in our Gemara it implies b'dieved specifically]; and Or Zarua resolved and rejected Rabeinu Tam's proof on another matter; and Rif wrote further even though R' Levi said hot bread, etc., nullified as written — and this too, etc., the halachah is not like R' Levi against Levi and Rava and R' Levi does not exist at all and in all of them they disagree; and the halachah is like R' Yehudah against R' Meir as written in Eruvin chapter 4; and R' Yossi holds not to disagree on R' Yehudah except because barley draws the wine itself and it is not reicha; and proof R' Meir forbade and did not explain his reason and R' Yossi needed to explain — and so Rambam and like R' Yossi and investigate; and likewise one may say on Rav Kahana and Rava of Parzika who rejected the first Rava — the latter is he and Mar bar Rav Ashi did not agree with them — and so Ran:
And if the oven, etc., and its mouth, etc. Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there s.v. Rava even according to Rav:
Provided, etc. For even cold they said in beginning of chapter 25 siman 107 wrote provided, etc.:
And if one, etc., for it is like two pots which is permitted even according to Rav — Tosafot Pesachim s.v. it forbade, etc.:
And the same applies, etc. As written there Rav Kahana taught, etc.:

And we practice, etc. So too Issur VeHeter and he holds that what Tosafot wrote to distinguish between large and small oven is b'dieved for Rav — but for us who establish nullified there is no difference; but all poskim wrote as in Shulchan Aruch and ben yomo siman 97:
And if he baked, etc. As above from Rav Kahana taught and Rava acted, etc.:
And likewise if, etc. For what Levi permitted of an Israelite is b'dieved:

Permitted in both. Meaning even in gentile cooking unlike Rif who wrote another reason on Rav Kahana because since it is possible to eat without kutach it is something that has a permitted aspect and even in a thousand it is not nullified — in such a case Levi agrees and according to his approach that Rav who forbids goes according to his taste because he holds min b'mino in any amount — therefore we do not establish like Rav because we establish in sixty — but in such a case he agrees to Rav. But they challenged him that such a case is not called something that has a permitted aspect as in Yevamot chapter 2; and something that has a permitted aspect in min she'eino mino is nullified; and if so fish that came up to the bowl why permitted; and behold even by itself he permits in his daughter; and even if the first two questions were answered in chapter 6 of Nedarim and regarding fish there is no question for there is not even any amount and from his daughter there is no question as in ShaDa as above — nevertheless the main point is Rif's first answer as above; but in the main law Darkei Moshe and Turei Chayim challenged — behold oil and honey of gentiles permitted l'chatchila to buy on account of nat bar lichtamei as in chapter 2 of Avodah Zarah and we do not say it is l'chatchila; and also what the Rav permitted even in gentile cooking requires study since it is possible to eat without milk it is l'chatchila as Rif wrote and so Rambam in chapter 8 of forbidden and did not distinguish even though he ruled nullified in forbidden foods — and so in the Gemara they concluded forbidden to eat in kutach:
Some say there is no, etc. For it is similar to hot bread and open barrel which is forbidden as written in seif 4 that even Levi agrees (and see s.k. 30):
And in a place, etc. According to the view of all poskim who disagree with him:

And if the issur, etc. With this is resolved that R' Levi does not disagree with Levi and Rava unlike Rif and Rambam and as Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there in hot bread and open barrel even Rava agrees and as Shulchan Aruch wrote in seif 4:
And all the more if, etc. See siman 122 seif 3 in hagahah some say in things, etc., but, etc.

(Likut) And all the more if, etc. So he learned from Issur VeHeter as in siman 122 seif 3 in hagahah but if, etc., and his words are astonishing from Terumot chapter 10 chasis, etc., and one must distinguish between in the substance and absorbed issur — see there (end):
But if one, etc. As above in Shulchan Aruch and like hot bread and covered barrel.

(Likut) But if one of them, etc. From covered house which is permitted even in hot bread and even according to R' Yossi it is forbidden only in barley which draws — but otherwise like wheat permitted and so we establish in seif 4 (end):

If they baked or, etc. So Issur VeHeter wrote and he follows his approach that even in closed oven he forbids b'dieved because it is like the house open and hot bread — and so ShaDa in name of Raavan and what he wrote uncovered as above; but from Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there it implies specifically according to Rav as they wrote and regarding reicha there, etc., this applies, etc., and the same, etc., and what he wrote above and in place of loss, etc., and nevertheless he did not want to be lenient here:
And the same if, etc. For they have one law as above:
But one after the other, etc. As in Avodah Zarah there it is different there because it weakens, etc., and even though smell remains in the oven even Abbaye agrees:
Unless, etc. As above from we kasher:

And for need of loss, etc. But otherwise each piece needs sixty for we do not know to which side the smell went; but since all are in doubt all join as written in siman 111 seif 7; and the Rav follows his approach that he wrote there too and for need of loss; and even though he wrote there nevertheless one may not eat, etc., in reicha one may be lenient as Issur VeHeter wrote:

Some say issur, etc. So Tosafot in Avodah Zarah there and so Rif who wrote therefore we do not establish like Rav because he goes according to his taste as above; and the fact they forbade eating in kutach because it is something that has a permitted aspect.

(Likut) Some say issur that forbids, etc. This dispute depends on the dispute of Rif and Tosafot — Rif brings proof halachah is nullified from Avodah Zarah in his daughter and there it is issur in substance and nevertheless permitted — all the more in mixture since in substance it is not forbidden at all; and as Ran challenged Rif in chapter Gid on what Rif wrote Rav goes according to his taste, etc.; and kutach forbidden because something that has a permitted aspect — see there; but for Tosafot who hold it does not depend on Avodah Zarah there — even for one who says it is not significant there it is forbidden in substance and Rava who permits because it harms as Tosafot there s.v. Abbaye and s.v. Rava — see there — therefore Tosafot forbid ziluf there and according to Rif it would be permitted but his explanation is forbidden because one benefits; and likewise in mixture — and on this depends whether halachah is like Rav or nullified; and the matter in seif 4 comes like Tosafot but for Rif it does not exist and R' Levi at all and even in open barrel and hot bread permitted for it is not significant and even in substance permitted as Rif wrote and so Rambam; and what is written in seif 5 in hagahah and forbidden to ziluf, etc., as above; and what is written in seif 6 sack, etc., and Be'er HaGolah there — and at first glance it is astonishing for if so also in eating it should be permitted; and furthermore what is it that he does not intend — it is pesik reisha; and Tosafot in chapter 25 daf 25 s.v. not possible, etc., deals, etc., except Rashba follows his approach that he wrote in seif 7 in spices, etc., forbidden and distinguishes between rose and blood whose essence is for smell which is forbidden unlike wine whose essence is not for smell therefore it is not significant; and according to Rif who compares to chapter 25 there too meat's essence is not for smell; but Tosafot do not hold this distinction except in his daughter because it harms as Tosafot there and there 12b s.v. except, etc., and as in seif 7 — and accordingly forbidden here (end):
If, etc. Not like Tosafot there and Shach:

And some say, etc. And his proof from Lechem HaPanim that all were baked in one oven — we do not find baked separately except the two loaves and Lechem HaPanim as in Rif chapter 1 of Menachot; and he holds one should not distinguish between large and small oven below — otherwise behold it holds twenty tenths; and also according to Rashba their dispute is specifically when one of them is fatty as in the Gemara and so Tosafot there s.v. let us say there is no proof from there. And it seems proof from that it challenges Rav from one may not roast, etc. — perhaps Rav forbade only min b'mino and kid and lamb is min she'eino mino as Beit Yosef siman 98 in name of Agur — if so there is no distinction and what is written there let us say kid and kid and let us say, etc., unlike Rif; and that it says there for Rav let us say, etc., even in such a case Rav instructs; and likewise in Avodah Zarah it challenges from terumah cumin and from the simple challenge it implies there is no distinction:

segments.he: חתיכה כו'. עבה"ג ממשמעות כו' דאפילו כו' דאל"ה לא משני שם ושם בע"ח חשיבי חה"ל שאני ביצה חשובה כו' דכ"ז מדרבנן כמ"ש בסי' ק"י ס"א בהג"ה ובב"מ נ"ג א' משא"כ במעשר דבטיל ברובא ועתוס' שם ד"ה ועולה וע"כ במעשר אף מדרבנן:
segments.en: Piece, etc. Abudraham from the implication, etc., that even, etc. — for otherwise it would not answer there and there in Orach Chaim they consider eggs important like wet in wet because an egg is important, etc., that all is d'rabbanan as written in siman 110 seif 1 in the hagahah and in Bava Metzia 53a — unlike terumah which is nullified in the majority; and Tosafot there s.v. Ve'olah — and therefore in terumah even d'rabbanan:

segments.he: מין במינה. לאפוקי בשא"מ דצריך ס' דלא ליתי לידי איסורא דאורייתא אם יבשלנה משא"כ במין במינו דאף בבישול מותר ברובו מד"ת:
segments.en: Same kind in its kind. To exclude when not its kind, which requires sixty so that one not come to a d'oraisa issur if he cooks it — unlike in same kind in its kind, where even in cooking it is permitted in the majority from the Torah:

segments.he: דהיינו כו'. ר"ל דל"ת יבש ממש אלא שאין כו' דהא פריך בחולין שם על גיד וחתיכה וליבטלו ברובא:
segments.en: Meaning, etc. Meaning: not literally dry, but that it is not, etc., for it challenges in Chullin there regarding gid and a piece — let them be nullified in the majority:

segments.he: חד בתרי. הטור לישנא דגמ' דגטין נ"ד ב' נקט אבל באמת א"צ אלא רובא כמ"ש במקומות הנ"ל וכן בגטין שם כ' רש"י משום דכתיב אחרי רבים כו' וכן בכמה מקומות בש"ס:
segments.en: One in two. Tur used the language of the Gemara in Gittin 54b, but in truth only a majority is required, as written in the places mentioned; and likewise in Gittin there Rashi wrote: because it is written "after the majority incline," etc.; and so in several places in the Gemara: But he may not, etc.

segments.he: אבל לא כו'. דטעם הביטול דעל כ"א שאוכל אומר זה הוא ההיתר משא"כ בבת אחת ועתוס' דזבחים ע"ד ד"ה פירש. א"נ משום כו' וכמ"ש בפ"א דפסחים (יו"ד א') ובפ"ב דכתובות בשני שבילין בזא"ז ד"ה טהור בכ"א כו':
segments.en: For the reason of nullification is that regarding each one he eats, he says this is the heter — unlike all at once; and Tosafot in Zevachim 74 s.v. Peresh. Alternatively, because, etc., as written in chapter 1 of Pesachim (YD 1) and chapter 2 of Ketubot regarding two paths one opposite the other s.v. Tahor — regarding each one, etc.: And there is one who, etc. Tosafot in Chullin there s.v.

segments.he: ויש כו'. תוס' בחולין שם ד"ה בריה וכמ"ש בספ"ז דתרומות אין ידוע כו' אכל אחר את כו' אכל אחד את שתיהן כו' והרא"ש פליג על כ"ז ומתיר אף לאכלן בב"א וכתב דהאיסור נהפך להיתר ולא משום ספיקא דגזירת הכתוב היא אחרי רבים להטות ולכן לא תנא כאן ב' ספיקות כמו בדבר חשוב בזבחים שם דנקט ב' ספיקות כדי להתיר לאכלן בב"א וכן לא אמר כאן לאכלן שנים שנים:
segments.en: Beriah, and as written at the end of chapter 7 of Terumot — it is not known, etc., one ate the other, etc., each one ate both of them, etc.; and Rosh disagrees with all this and permits even to eat them all at once, and wrote that the issur transformed to heter and not on account of safek of the biblical decree "after the majority incline" — therefore it did not teach here two doubts like in an important matter in Zevachim there, which teaches two doubts in order to permit eating them all at once; and likewise it did not say here to eat them two by two: And some are stringent, etc. Rashi in Avodah Zarah 74a s.v. Tartei [and according to his approach in chapter HaTa'aruvot 74a — Rishon Acharon permits even all three, etc., because he explained that one of them went elsewhere] — and Rosh there and Rash in chapter 3 of Orlah already challenged him, for we say there (chapter 2) one need not remove except from terumah on account of robbing the tribe; and as written in Yerushalmi there: here you say removal is required, here you say removal is not required — R' Yaakov bar Zavdi, R' Avahu in name of R' Yochanan: on account of robbing the tribe; and it teaches thus: any terumah that kohanim are not particular about, such as terumah of beans, carobs, and barley in Edom — removal is not required, etc.; and this is what he meant "and it is only a general stringency" — that Maharam was stringent on himself:

segments.he: ויש מחמירין כו'. רש"י בע"ז ע"ד א' ד"ה תרתי [וכשיטתו בפ' התערובת ע"ד א' רש"א כו' מותר אף הג' כו' משום דפירש מהן א' למקום אחר] וכבר השיגו הרא"ש שם והר"ש בפ"ג דערלה דהא אמרינן שם (בפ"ב) וא"צ להרים רק בתרומה משום גזל השבט וכמ"ש בירושלמי שם הכא את אמר צריך להרים והכא את אמר א"צ להרים ר' יעקב בר זבדי ר' אבהו בשם ר' יוחנן מפני גזל השבט ותני כן כל תרומה שאין הכהנים מקפידין עליה כגון תרומת הכליסין והחרובין והשעורים שבאדום א"צ להרים כו' וז"ש ואינו אלא כו' שמהר"ם החמיר בעצמו:
segments.en: (Likkut) And some are stringent, etc. Rashi in chapter 1 of Yoma (3b), and the difficulty they raised on him from what is written in Terumot on account of robbing the tribe — explain that there everything is mixed together and one cannot eat the issur alone — unlike in a dry matter; Mordechai there siman 484 (end): And there is no distinction in all this, etc. Unlike Hagahot ShaDa who wrote that in d'rabbanan one in one is nullified; and so in Hagahot Alfasi chapter 5 of Avodah Zarah before the mishnah "and these are forbidden," etc., they learned from what is written in Yerushalmi regarding challah: R' Avahu taught in its harvest that it requires a majority — R' Yonah said: it teaches that it ascends in less than a hundred and is not forbidden;

segments.he: (ליקוט) ויש מחמירין כו'. רש"י בפ"ק די"ט (ג' ב') והקושיא שהקשו עליו ממ"ש בתרומה משום גזל השבט תי' דשם מעורב הכל ביחד וא"י לאכול האיסור לבדו משא"כ בדבר יבש מרדכי שם סי' תתרכ"ד (ע"כ):
segments.en: R' Zeira said: the mishnah said so — even one in one, as we taught "and it is eaten with the zar on the table" — it is not so, for there specifically they were lenient because even in Eretz Yisrael it is only d'rabbanan, as they were lenient there to nullify it l'chatchila as written above siman 99 seif 6; and all the more so according to what Rash wrote in chapter 4 of Challah and Tosafot in Menachot 67a s.v.

segments.he: ואין חילוק כו'. דלא כהגש"ד שכתב דבדרבנן חד בחד בטל וכ"כ בהג"א פ"ה דע"ז בד"ה מיהו בדבר כו' קודם למתני' ואלו אסורין כו' ולמדו ממ"ש בירושלמי דחלה הורה ר' אבהו בבוצרה שצריכה רוב א"ר יונה מלמד שהיא עולה בפחות ממאה ואינה נאסרת א"ר זעירא מתני' אמרה כן אפילו אחת באחת דתנינן ונאכלת עם הזר על השלחן וליתא דדוקא בה הקילו שאף בא"י אינה אלא מדרבנן כמו שהקילו בה לבטלה לכתחלה כמש"ל סי' צ"ט ס"ו וכ"ש לפי מ"ש הר"ש בפ"ד דחלה ותוס' במנחות ס"ז א' ד"ה ותרומתו דלא קי"ל כירושלמי אלא צריך א' ומאה ממ"ש שם דתרומת עובד כוכבים בח"ל אינה מדמעת משמע דישראל בח"ל מדמעת ומ"ש בבכורות כ"ז א' ובטלה ברוב היינו לכהן בימי טומאתו וכ"כ שם ד"ה תרומת וכמש"ל סי' שכ"ג ס"א בהג"ה ומדכתב הרב ואין חילוק בכ"ז כו'. משמע דקאי גם אמין בשא"מ דצריך ס' וכ"כ בסה"ת וטור סי' שכ"ג ואם נתערבה בככרות אחרות במינו כו' ומין בשא"מ בטלה בס' ובשא"מ שוה תרומה וחלה לשאר איסורים דלא כש"ך:
segments.en: VeTerumato that we do not hold like Yerushalmi, rather one in a hundred is required — from what is written there that terumah of a gentile in chutz la'aretz does not cause demai implies that an Israelite in chutz la'aretz causes demai; and what is written in Bekhorot 27a "and it is nullified in the majority" — meaning to the kohen in his days of impurity; and so there s.v. Terumat and as written above siman 123 seif 1 in the hagahah; and since the Rav wrote "and there is no distinction in all this," etc. — it implies he refers also to same kind when not its kind which requires sixty; and so in Sefer HaTerumah and Tur siman 123; and if it became mixed in other loaves in its kind, etc., and same kind when not its kind is nullified in sixty, and same kind when not its kind equals terumah and challah to other issurim — unlike Shach:

segments.he: (ליקוט) ואין חילוק כו'. דלא כהגש"ד שכ' דבדרבנן אף חד בחד וליתא ולא דמי למ"ש בסי' קי"א ס"א וס"ב וכמ"ש ביבמות פ"ב ב' ואב"א שאני כו' אלמא אף בדרבנן חוזר וניעור בפלגא אף שאין חוזר וניעור רק בדאורייתא מ"מ בפלגא הוי כמו בעין ועתוס' שם ד"ה אר"י כו' וד"ה דלא כו' (ע"כ):
segments.en: (Likkut) And there is no distinction, etc. Unlike Hagahot ShaDa who wrote that in d'rabbanan even one in one — it is not so; and it is not comparable to what is written in siman 111 seif 1 and seif 2, and as written in Yevamot chapter 2:2 "and the other says it is different," etc. — evidently even in d'rabbanan it returns and revives in half, even though it only returns and revives in d'oraisa; nevertheless in half it is as if in its substance; and Tosafot there s.v. Amar R' Yehudah, etc., and s.v. D'lo, etc. (end):

segments.he: (ליקוט) ואין חילוק כו'. ר"ל דבעינן ס' כמ"ש בפג"ה (צ"ח א') לא תזלזל בשיעורא דרבנן ושם מין במינו הוא חלב ובשר (וע"ל ר"ס צ"ה) וה"ה כאן מין בשא"מ דשוה לשם מין במינו דכולהו חד טעמא גזירה מין בשא"מ בבישול דנ"ט (ע"כ):
segments.en: (Likkut) And there is no distinction, etc. Meaning: we require sixty, as written in Pesachim (98a) "do not treat lightly the measures of the rabbis"; and there same kind in its kind is milk and meat (and see above siman 95) — and the same here, same kind when not its kind equals there same kind in its kind, for all are one reason — a decree of same kind when not its kind in cooking because of noten ta'am (end):

segments.he: ואפילו כו'. שכבר גזרו על כל גבינות העובדי כוכבים בין שהעמידוה בדבר אסור בין שהעמידוה בדבר המותר גזירה משום שמעמידין אותה בדבר האסור לשון הרמב"ם. דע"כ לא חילקו בין גבינה לגבינה מדפריך שם אלא מעתה יבש תשתרי ישן תשתרי ודלמא אין ה"נ אלא ודאי כשאסרוה לגמרי אסרוה ולא חילקו וגמ' פריך למה לא חילקו ואמרו שם גזירה חדשה כו' אלמא אסרו משום גזירה ונאסרה במנין וכ"כ כל הפוסקים דלא כמ"ש תוס' שם ד"ה חדא כו'. ואין לדמות לשאר דברים שהותרו בבטל הסיבה שלא אסרו לכתחלה אלא לפי הענין ועריב"ש סי' שצ"ד ובחלב מחלק פעמים שאסור ופעמים שמותר וכן בכבשים ושאר דברים ולא מחלק בגבינה ועהג"מ:
segments.en: And even, etc. For they already decreed on all cheeses of gentiles, whether they curdled it with a forbidden substance or curdled it with a permitted substance — a decree because they curdle it with a forbidden substance — language of the Rambam. Understandably they did not distinguish between one cheese and another, since it challenges there: if so dry should be permitted old should be permitted; and perhaps the same applies only when they forbade it completely they forbade it and did not distinguish; and the Gemara challenges: why did they not distinguish? And they said there: a new decree, etc.; hence they forbade on account of a decree and it is forbidden by vote; and so all the poskim, not as Tosafot there d"h chada, etc., wrote. And one should not compare to other matters that were permitted when the reason was nullified, that they did not forbid l'chatchila except according to the matter; and Rivash siman 194; and in milk he sometimes distinguishes forbidden and sometimes permitted; and so with sheep and other matters; and he does not distinguish with cheese — and Hagahot Maimoniyot.

segments.he: ואם הישראל רואה כו'. כ"כ מהר"ם סי' שע"ד בשם תוספתא פ"ה פת שאפאה עובד כוכבים בלא מעמד ישראל וגבינה שהעמיד העובד כוכבים בלא מעמד ישראל אסור ובתוספתא שלנו חסר בבא דגבינה אבל כתכ מהר"מ שם דלאו דוקא שהרי בסיפא אמר פת שאפאה ישראל אע"פ שהעובד כוכבים לשה וגבינה שהעמידה ישראל אע"פ שהעובד כוכבים עבדה מותר אלמא דהעמדת ישראל בעינן וכן בפת ע"כ א"א לומר דבפני ישראל מהני כמ"ש בגמ' דוקא א' מג' מלאכות בעי:
segments.en: And if the Jew sees, etc. So too Maharam siman 474 in the name of Tosefta chapter 5: bread that a gentile baked without Jewish presence and cheese that a gentile curdled without Jewish presence is forbidden; and in our Tosefta the matter of cheese is missing in the first section; but Maharam wrote there that it is not specific, for behold in the latter section it says: bread that a Jew baked even though the gentile kneaded it, and cheese that a Jew curdled even though the gentile worked it is permitted — hence Jewish curdling we require; and so with bread — necessarily one cannot say that in the presence of a Jew it helps, as the Gemara says: specifically one of three labors is required.

segments.he: ואם ראה כו'. דלהכי צריכי טעמים אחרים בגבינה שם ועתוס' ל"ה ב' ד"ה לגבינה כו' ושם א' ד"ה לפי כו' וכ"ז לשיטתו אבל לפי מ"ש לעיל דוקא שהעמיד ישראל:
segments.en: And if he saw, etc. For therefore other reasons are needed in cheese there; and Tosafot folio 35b d"h ligvinah, etc., and there one d"h lefi, etc.; and all this is according to his method; but according to what is written above, specifically that a Jew curdled.

segments.he: (ליקוט) ואם הישראל כו' ואם ראה כו'. דלפי' תוס' שם ד"ה לפי כו' סגי בראיית עשיית הגבינה לחוד דכל החששות שם משום ההעמדה חוץ מדריב"ל והשתא לא חיישינן לדריב"ל כמש"ש בתוס' ד"ה חדא אלא דלפירש"י שם ד"ה לפי צריך לראות גם החליבה משום דר' חנינא וכמש"ש ב' ואב"א כו' ועתוס' שם ד"ה לגבינה כו' ועמ"ש בס"ג (ע"כ):
segments.en: (Collection) And if the Jew, etc., and if he saw, etc. According to Tosafot there d"h lefi, sight of making the cheese alone suffices, for all the concerns there are on account of curdling except for Rabbenu Levi; and now we are not concerned for Rabbenu Levi as Tosafot wrote d"h chada; rather according to Rashi there d"h lefi one must also see the milking on account of Rabbi Chanina, as is written in the second answer and the other answer; and Tosafot there d"h ligvinah, etc.; and see what is written in seif 93 (end).

segments.he: ומ"מ כו'. כנ"ל סס"א ור"ל כאן אפילו היה דעת העובד כוכבים לעשות הגבינות וכמ"ש אפילו תימא כו' ומשמע אפילו דעת העובד כוכבים לעשות גבינות נמי אסור:
segments.en: Nevertheless, etc. As above seif 66; and meaning: here even if the gentile's intent was to make cheeses; and as is written: even if you say, etc.; and it implies even if the gentile's intent is to make cheeses it is also forbidden.

segments.he: אם הוא כו'. כתי' דאביי דרבא ל"פ עליה וכהנך עובדי רשם. ורש"י פי' שבידו לטמאו ולהפסידו ונאמן מחמת מינו. והרא"ש שם ומרדכי ר"פ האשה רבה כתבו משום שהוא כבעליו וראיה ממש"ש אזכרות שבו כו' אע"ג שכבר נכתבו ואין בידו וכן בטהרות ג"כ ל"ל מינו דהא חייב לשלם וביבמות שם אלא דאחר כו' משום דבידו לתקנו אטו בשופטני עסקינן שיתרום על של חבירו וע' מרדכי שם:
segments.en: If it is, etc. Abaye's words ; Rava does not explain them, and these acts of designation. And Rashi explained that he has in his power to defile it and ruin it, and he is believed because of migo. And Rosh there and Mordechai chapter HaIsha Rabba wrote because he is like the owner; and proof from what he wrote regarding the mentions in it, etc., even though they were already written and it is not in his hand; and likewise in purities too there is no need for migo, for he is obligated to pay; and in Yevamot there ; except that afterward, etc., because it is in his power to fix it ; are we dealing with fools that he would separate terumah on his fellow's produce? And see Mordechai there:

segments.he: ואפילו כו'. דקי"ל הלכה כרבא ואע"ג דהנך עובדי שם כאביי כבר תירץ הרא"ש שם ע"ש:
segments.en: And even if, etc. For we establish the halachah follows Rava; and even though those acts there are like Abaye ; the Rosh already answered there ; see there:

segments.he: אפילו כו'. דבשותק אפילו לא היה בידו מעולם נאמן כמ"ש בקדושין ס"ה ב' אכלת חלב כו' ועתוס' שם ד"ה נטמאו כו' ובגטין שם ר"ה אמר כו' והביאו ראיה ממש"ש וצריכא כו' אי לאו דקים כו' וביבמות שם במסקנא אלא לאו משום דאשתיק כו':
segments.en: Even as a. He had never been faithful in his hand as "the Holy One" and he was given the name of his son-in-law, and he was given the word of his son and his father's son, and he was given his name to him, "And he was given his name to him."

segments.he: אבל אם כו'. אם היה בידו פ"א דבלא"ה בכ"ע אינו נאמן:
segments.en: But if they are . If he was in his hand, he was not faithful

segments.he: תוך כדי דיבור. דאל"כ הרי כבר הודה ועבפ"ק דב"מ ו' א' ובב"ב קל"ח א':
segments.en: Within the time of speech. For otherwise behold he already admitted; and in the first chapter of Bava Metzia 6a and in Bava Batra 138a:

segments.he: או אומר כו'. ממש"ש וא"ל זבחים כו' והתם אינו יכול להכחישו מרדכי בקדושין שם:
segments.en: Or says, etc. From what he wrote: and he told him in Zevachim, etc., and there he cannot contradict him ; Mordechai in Kiddushin there:

segments.he: אבל אם שתק כו'. אפילו לא היה בידו מעולם כמו בקדושין שם:
segments.en: But if you are silent.” He had never been in his hand like a saint there:

segments.he: ומלמדין כו'. טור וע"ל בהג"ה ואם הבעלים כו' אע"ג דבלבו כו' וע"ש בהגמ"ר שהקשה דא"כ הל"ל לשמואל לומר לסמיא אמור איני מאמינך וכ"כ תוס' בקדושין שם דאי מהימן כבי תרי אפילו מכחישו נאמן מכה ההיא ראיה ועש"ך ס"ק ט"ו:
segments.en: And we teach him, etc. Tur; and see above in the gloss "and if the owners," etc., "even though in his heart," etc.; and see there in Hagahot Maimoniyot, who challenged: if so, Shmuel should have told the blind man "say I do not believe you"; and likewise Tosafot in Kiddushin there ; if he is believed like two, even if they contradict him he is believed ; reject that proof; and see Shach s.k. 15:

segments.he: ואז לכ"ע כו'. הוא ענין בפ"ע וכמו בשורך נרבע דמותר לגבוה וכיוצא:
segments.en: And then according to all, etc. It is the matter in its own right, like "your ox was sodomized" ; permitted for the Most High, and the like:

segments.he: ויש מי כו'. כמש"ש בקדושין ע"א בהכחשה כו' וער"ן בפ"ב דכתובות גבי ע"א אומר נתקדשה כו' ועח"מ סי' פ"ב סי"ב וסי' מ"ו סל"ז ועבה"ג שם ס"ק כ' בשם הריטב"א. וסברא הראשוגה ס"ל מאחר שהבעלים שם ושותקין הוי כהודאה ועש"ך:
segments.en: And some, etc. As he wrote in Kiddushin 71a regarding contradiction, etc.; and in Ran chapter 2 of Ketubot regarding one witness who says "she was betrothed," etc.; and in Orach Mishpat siman 82 seif 2 and siman 46 s.l. 37; and in Bach there s.k. 20 in the name of Ritva. And the first reasoning holds: since the owners are there and are silent, it is like admission ; and see Shach:

segments.he: והוא שיאמר כו'. תוס' שם וש"פ וראיה מב"מ ל"ז ב' וע' במרדכי דקדושין שם:
segments.en: He said yes. Hashem’s name is “Ps 119:105; 119:105; 119:130].”

segments.he: ואם שתק כו'. ג"כ מגמ' דב"מ הנ"ל. שם ושם. וכ"ז שיטת התוס' ורא"ש ומרדכי וש"פ הנמשכין אחריהם אבל הרמב"ן והרשב"א והריטב"א בקדושין שם הקשו על שיטתם חדא דלא הל"ל בקדושין שם ע"א כו' נאמן דהא לאו משום נאמנותו אלא משום שהבעלים שותקים והל"ל א"ל ע"א אכלת חלב חייב נטמאו טהרותיך כו' טמאות כלישנא דמתני' וכמ"ש ביבמות שם ממאי דנאמן דלמא כו' ועוד דכולה שמעתא דקדושין איפכא משמע דהא אשתו זינתה דפליג רבא ואמר הוי דבר כו' ואי משום הודאתו ל"ל שנים הא שויה עלי' חתיכה דאיסורא והא רבא מודה בהנך לאביי ועוד ההוא סמיא לא ידע אי קושטא קאמר ופירשה אביי אי מהימן לך דלאו גזלנא כו' ועובדא דינאי הא צווח וקטיל. אלא דכל אדם נאמן לעולם אפי' לא היה בידו מעולם בשותק אפילו לא היה לו לידע או שאומר איני יודע ובכה"ג ההיא דקדושין וההיא דגטין איירי בפועל דעליה רמיא לאודועיה ולכן אינו נאמן אלא דוקא בידו או בפעם ראשון אבל במכחישו לעולם אינו נאמן בכ"ע וכ"כ הר"ן בגטין שם בקיצור וכ' הרשב"א וא"ת מנ"ל לאביי דקאמר ותנא תונא כו' דלמא משום דשתיקה כהודאה כמ"ש ביבמות שם י"ל דה"ק טעמא כו' דוקא לא הא אמר א"י (מהימן) דאל"כ ליתני א"י ומ"ש ביבמות שם וממאי דמשום דמהימן כו' קאי אמש"ש מדאורייתא מנ"ל כו' ואכתי מדאורייתא מנ"ל ומש"ש תדע דקתני כו' סוגיא דשם כההוא סברא שאמרו בכריתות י"ב א' טעמא דרבנן משום דאדם נאמן כו' אבל אביי סבר דטעמא משום מיגו מתרצינן לדיבוריה ולההוא לישנא רישא משום דנאמן הוא דכי קפטרי רבנן משום דלא מהימני במכחישין משום מיגו א"נ כההיא לישנא דמוקים שם מתני' כר"מ. והא דקאמר וצריכא כו' ה"ק דסד"א דטעמא לאו משום נאמנות אלא משום דשתיקה כהודאה דמיא ע"ש שהאריך והר"ן הביאו אבל כ' דשיטת תוס' עיקר כי כן מוכיחין סוגיות הנ"ל אלא דטעם שתיקה כהודאה הוא משום העדאת העד דגזירת הכתוב הוא דכל דשתיק העד נאמן ולכן כל שאין העד נאמן דהיינו גזלן וכיוצא אינו נאמן. ובזה מתורץ מה שהקשה דלמה קאמר נאמן וכן מה שהקשה ממש"ש דלאו גזלנא כו' וז"ש רבא אין דבר שבערוה כו' ר"ל בערוה ע"א אין נאמן כלל והוי כגזלן או פסול ומ"ש ביבמות שם וממאי משום כו' ה"ק ממאי דנאמן אפילו באומר אני יודע דלמא אינו יודע כמכחישו אלא דוקא היכא דאשתיק ועובדא דינאי דלמא פ"א שתק וכנ"ל דודאי תוך כ"ד ע"ש:
segments.en: And if he was silent, etc. Also from the Gemara in Bava Metzia cited. There. And there. And all this is the view of Tosafot, Rosh, Mordechai, and Shitat HaKadmonim who follow them; but Ramban, Rashba, and Ritva in Kiddushin there challenged their view: one, that it should not have said in Kiddushin there 71a, etc., "he is believed," for it is not because of his credibility but because the owners are silent ; it should have said "he told him one witness: you ate forbidden fat, your purities became impure," etc., "impure" in the language of the mishnah; and as written in Yevamot there ; whence is he believed? Perhaps, etc.; and further, the entire discussion in Kiddushin implies the opposite, for "his wife committed adultery" ; Rava disagrees and says it becomes a matter, etc.; and if because of his admission, why need two? Behold he made upon her a piece of prohibition; and Rava agrees with those to Abaye; and further, that blind man did not know if he spoke truth, and Abaye explained: if you believe me that I am not a robber, etc.; and the case of King Yannai ; he shouted and killed. Rather every person is always believed even if it was never in his hand, when silent ; even if he had no way to know, or says "I do not know"; and in such a case that in Kiddushin and that in Gittin deals with a worker upon whom it is incumbent to inform, and therefore he is not believed except specifically when in his hand or the first time; but when they contradict him, he is never believed according to all; and likewise Ran in Gittin there briefly; and Rashba wrote: and you may ask whence for Abaye who says and teaches, etc. ; perhaps because silence is like admission as written in Yevamot there; one may say this is what he means: the reason, etc., specifically not "I do not know" (believed), for otherwise it should teach "I do not know"; and what is written in Yevamot there "and whence that he is believed," etc., refers to what is written above "whence for us from Scripture," etc., and still "whence for us from Scripture"; and what is written "know that it teaches," etc. ; the discussion there follows that reasoning they said in Keritot 12a: the reason of the rabbis is because a person is believed, etc.; but Abaye holds the reason is because of migo ; we resolve his words; and for that language at the beginning, because he is believed ; when the rabbis reject because they are not believed when contradicted, it is because of migo. And what it says "and it is necessary," etc. ; this is what he means: one might have thought the reason is not credibility but because silence is like admission ; see there where he elaborated, and Ran brought them; but he wrote that Tosafot's view is primary, as those discussions prove; except the reason silence is like admission is because of the witness's testimony, for it is a decree of Scripture that whoever is silent, the witness is believed; therefore whoever the witness is not believed ; meaning a robber and the like ; he is not believed. And with this what he challenged ; why does it say "he is believed," and likewise what he challenged from what is written "I am not a robber," etc. ; is resolved; and these are Rava's words: there is no matter of sexual impropriety, etc., meaning in sexual impropriety one witness is not believed at all and he is like a robber or disqualified; and what is written in Yevamot there "and whence because," etc. ; this is what he means: whence is he believed even when saying "I know," for perhaps he does not know like his contradiction; but specifically where he was silent; and the case of King Yannai ; perhaps he was silent at first ; and likewise certainly within twenty-four hours ; see there:

segments.he: ואם לא כו'. כמ"ש בכתובות כ"ב א' ועבא"ע סי' קנ"ב ס"ו:
segments.en: And if not, etc. As written in Ketubot 22a and in Even HaEzer siman 152 seif 6:

segments.he: וכל מי שנאמן כו'. כמ"ש מנו במקום עדים לא אמרינן בפ"ו דב"מ (פ"א ב') ופ"ג דב"ב וש"מ:
segments.en: And whoever is believed, etc. As written: we counted him in place of witnesses ; we do not say in chapter 6 of Bava Metzia (chapter 1 2) and chapter 3 of Bava Batra; and learn from this:

segments.he: מ"מ לדידיה כו'. כמ"ש בכתובות כ"ג ב' ועתוס' דיבמות מ"ז א' ד"ה נאמן כו' וד"ה ואין כו':
segments.en: Nevertheless for him, etc. As written in Ketubot 23b; and in Tosafot Yevamot 47a s.v. he is believed, etc., and s.v. and there is not, etc.:

segments.he: טבח כו'. עמ"ש בס"ס א':
segments.en: The massacre of qua. A.S.:

segments.he: וכל הפסולי כו'. אבל הר"ן כתב דאינן נאמנין דלה"ק אי מהימן לך דלאו גזלנא הוא כו' כנ"ל וצ"ע וכן מ"ש אם לא שחשוד כו' הא אמרינן לעיל סי' קי"ט ס"ז ובשל אחרים כו' דקי"ל בפ"ח דיומא ובבכורות ל"ה ב' כרשב"ג דאמר נאמן על של חבירו כו' אלא דלהתיר נאמן אף החשוד אבל לאסור דנאמן מכח עדותו כל הפסולין אינן נאמנין כנ"ל וכן הקשה בש"ך וצ"ע:
segments.en: And all disqualified for testimony, etc. But Ran wrote they are not believed ; for this is what he means: if you believe me that he is not a robber, etc., as above ; requires investigation; and likewise what he wrote "unless he is suspected," etc. ; behold we say above siman 119 seif 7 "and regarding another's," etc., for we establish in chapter 8 of Yoma and in Bekhorot 35b like R. Shimon ben Gamliel, who said one is believed regarding his fellow's, etc.; except to permit he is believed even the suspected; but to forbid, he is believed by force of his testimony ; all the disqualified are not believed, as above; and likewise Shach challenged ; requires investigation:

segments.he: (ליקוט) וכל הפסולי עדות כו'. דקי"ל החשוד לדבר אחד אינו חשוד כו' [ועתוס' דבכורות ל"ו א' ד"ה אימור כו'] כמ"ש בסי' קי"ט ס"ד וס"ז:
segments.en: (Collection) And all disqualified for testimony, etc. For we establish: one suspected of one matter is not suspected, etc. [and in Tosafot Bekhorot 36a s.v. say, etc.] as written in siman 119 seif 4 and seif 7:

segments.he: אם לא כו'. ע"ש ס"ז דלא כ"כ שכ' ובשל אחרים כו' אבל כדברי הרב כן עיקר כמש"ש (בס"ק י"ח) (ע"כ):
segments.en: If not, etc. See there seif 7, that it is not as he wrote "and regarding another's," etc.; but according to the Rav's words, that is primary, as he wrote (in s.k. 18) (end of quote):

en_segments: If it is, etc. Abaye's words ; Rava does not explain them, and these acts of designation. And Rashi explained that he has in his power to defile it and ruin it, and he is believed because of migo. And Rosh there and Mordechai chapter HaIsha Rabba wrote because he is like the owner; and proof from what he wrote regarding the mentions in it, etc., even though they were already written and it is not in his hand; and likewise in purities too there is no need for migo, for he is obligated to pay; and in Yevamot there ; except that afterward, etc., because it is in his power to fix it ; are we dealing with fools that he would separate terumah on his fellow's produce? And see Mordechai there:
And even if, etc. For we establish the halachah follows Rava; and even though those acts there are like Abaye ; the Rosh already answered there ; see there:

Even as a. He had never been faithful in his hand as "the Holy One" and he was given the name of his son-in-law, and he was given the word of his son and his father's son, and he was given his name to him, "And he was given his name to him."
But if they are . If he was in his hand, he was not faithful
Within the time of speech. For otherwise behold he already admitted; and in the first chapter of Bava Metzia 6a and in Bava Batra 138a:
Or says, etc. From what he wrote: and he told him in Zevachim, etc., and there he cannot contradict him ; Mordechai in Kiddushin there:
But if you are silent.” He had never been in his hand like a saint there:

And we teach him, etc. Tur; and see above in the gloss "and if the owners," etc., "even though in his heart," etc.; and see there in Hagahot Maimoniyot, who challenged: if so, Shmuel should have told the blind man "say I do not believe you"; and likewise Tosafot in Kiddushin there ; if he is believed like two, even if they contradict him he is believed ; reject that proof; and see Shach s.k. 15:
And then according to all, etc. It is the matter in its own right, like "your ox was sodomized" ; permitted for the Most High, and the like:

And some, etc. As he wrote in Kiddushin 71a regarding contradiction, etc.; and in Ran chapter 2 of Ketubot regarding one witness who says "she was betrothed," etc.; and in Orach Mishpat siman 82 seif 2 and siman 46 s.l. 37; and in Bach there s.k. 20 in the name of Ritva. And the first reasoning holds: since the owners are there and are silent, it is like admission ; and see Shach:
He said yes. Hashem’s name is “Ps 119:105; 119:105; 119:130].”

And if he was silent, etc. Also from the Gemara in Bava Metzia cited. There. And there. And all this is the view of Tosafot, Rosh, Mordechai, and Shitat HaKadmonim who follow them; but Ramban, Rashba, and Ritva in Kiddushin there challenged their view: one, that it should not have said in Kiddushin there 71a, etc., "he is believed," for it is not because of his credibility but because the owners are silent ; it should have said "he told him one witness: you ate forbidden fat, your purities became impure," etc., "impure" in the language of the mishnah; and as written in Yevamot there ; whence is he believed? Perhaps, etc.; and further, the entire discussion in Kiddushin implies the opposite, for "his wife committed adultery" ; Rava disagrees and says it becomes a matter, etc.; and if because of his admission, why need two? Behold he made upon her a piece of prohibition; and Rava agrees with those to Abaye; and further, that blind man did not know if he spoke truth, and Abaye explained: if you believe me that I am not a robber, etc.; and the case of King Yannai ; he shouted and killed. Rather every person is always believed even if it was never in his hand, when silent ; even if he had no way to know, or says "I do not know"; and in such a case that in Kiddushin and that in Gittin deals with a worker upon whom it is incumbent to inform, and therefore he is not believed except specifically when in his hand or the first time; but when they contradict him, he is never believed according to all; and likewise Ran in Gittin there briefly; and Rashba wrote: and you may ask whence for Abaye who says and teaches, etc. ; perhaps because silence is like admission as written in Yevamot there; one may say this is what he means: the reason, etc., specifically not "I do not know" (believed), for otherwise it should teach "I do not know"; and what is written in Yevamot there "and whence that he is believed," etc., refers to what is written above "whence for us from Scripture," etc., and still "whence for us from Scripture"; and what is written "know that it teaches," etc. ; the discussion there follows that reasoning they said in Keritot 12a: the reason of the rabbis is because a person is believed, etc.; but Abaye holds the reason is because of migo ; we resolve his words; and for that language at the beginning, because he is believed ; when the rabbis reject because they are not believed when contradicted, it is because of migo. And what it says "and it is necessary," etc. ; this is what he means: one might have thought the reason is not credibility but because silence is like admission ; see there where he elaborated, and Ran brought them; but he wrote that Tosafot's view is primary, as those discussions prove; except the reason silence is like admission is because of the witness's testimony, for it is a decree of Scripture that whoever is silent, the witness is believed; therefore whoever the witness is not believed ; meaning a robber and the like ; he is not believed. And with this what he challenged ; why does it say "he is believed," and likewise what he challenged from what is written "I am not a robber," etc. ; is resolved; and these are Rava's words: there is no matter of sexual impropriety, etc., meaning in sexual impropriety one witness is not believed at all and he is like a robber or disqualified; and what is written in Yevamot there "and whence because," etc. ; this is what he means: whence is he believed even when saying "I know," for perhaps he does not know like his contradiction; but specifically where he was silent; and the case of King Yannai ; perhaps he was silent at first ; and likewise certainly within twenty-four hours ; see there:
And if not, etc. As written in Ketubot 22a and in Even HaEzer siman 152 seif 6:
And whoever is believed, etc. As written: we counted him in place of witnesses ; we do not say in chapter 6 of Bava Metzia (chapter 1 2) and chapter 3 of Bava Batra; and learn from this:
Nevertheless for him, etc. As written in Ketubot 23b; and in Tosafot Yevamot 47a s.v. he is believed, etc., and s.v. and there is not, etc.:
The massacre of qua. A.S.:

And all disqualified for testimony, etc. But Ran wrote they are not believed ; for this is what he means: if you believe me that he is not a robber, etc., as above ; requires investigation; and likewise what he wrote "unless he is suspected," etc. ; behold we say above siman 119 seif 7 "and regarding another's," etc., for we establish in chapter 8 of Yoma and in Bekhorot 35b like R. Shimon ben Gamliel, who said one is believed regarding his fellow's, etc.; except to permit he is believed even the suspected; but to forbid, he is believed by force of his testimony ; all the disqualified are not believed, as above; and likewise Shach challenged ; requires investigation:

(Collection) And all disqualified for testimony, etc. For we establish: one suspected of one matter is not suspected, etc. [and in Tosafot Bekhorot 36a s.v. say, etc.] as written in siman 119 seif 4 and seif 7:
If not, etc. See there seif 7, that it is not as he wrote "and regarding another's," etc.; but according to the Rav's words, that is primary, as he wrote (in s.k. 18) (end of quote):
